name: nuPlan: Closed-Loop ML-Based Planning Benchmark for Autonomous Vehicles
description: nuPlan is the world's first large-scale ML-based planning benchmark for autonomous vehicles, developed by Motional. It provides 1,300 hours of driving logs collected in Boston, Pittsburgh, Las Vegas, and Singapore with dense sensor streams, HD vector maps, and realistic closed-loop simulation environments. It enables evaluating learned driving policies against complex reactive agents in unconstrained urban environments.
